owner_creation.analysis: The ATTEMPTS static AtomicUsize owns the observed attempt count, reset to zero before a new startup plan is published.
owner_creation.invariant: Attempt state is a process-lifetime numeric counter.
limitations: ATTEMPTS owns checked bookkeeping rather than a history of allocation owners.

aliases_escapes.analysis: next_trigger receives a shared atomic reference; fetch_update serializes value changes without handing ATTEMPTS's storage to a callback or caller.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Shared references access the count only atomically.
limitations: A copied attempt count does not retain any object from that attempt.

callback_targets.analysis: ATTEMPTS.fetch_update applies a synchronous checked_add closure that retains no pager pointer or callback context.
callback_targets.invariant: Counter update closures cannot escape the operation.
limitations: The checked counter path cannot validate asynchronous allocation callers.

invalidation.analysis: No count borrow survives a move or free because this ATTEMPTS object never moves; reset is restricted to startup initialization.
invalidation.invariant: Counter address remains fixed for every hook.

mutation_commit.analysis: Each successful ATTEMPTS.fetch_update commits one count and returns the unique previous value used for ordinal selection.
mutation_commit.invariant: Each committed count transition has one previous value.

release_pair.analysis: next_trigger only borrows ATTEMPTS; the static counter owns no allocation and has no free operation.
release_pair.invariant: Neither next_trigger nor hit may deallocate the counter.
limitations: Counter exhaustion releases no heap object or descriptor.

error_cleanup.analysis: ATTEMPTS overflow returns an error instead of wrapping, and the exhaustion latch selects one explicit exhaustion report.
error_cleanup.invariant: Counter exhaustion never repeats an earlier ordinal.

signals_handoff.analysis: Interrupted ATTEMPTS increments remain atomic; the separate caller allocation and queue hazards are still unapproved.
signals_handoff.invariant: Hook reentry cannot tear the attempt count.
limitations: Initialize once before handler registration; M0-SIG-002 caller allocation/queue hazards remain open and are not cleared by this storage review.

finding_context.M0-SIG-002: ATTEMPTS uses checked atomic bookkeeping without retaining allocation owners. M0-SIG-002 describes unsafe asynchronous caller work rather than counter lifetime, so checking this scalar cannot discharge the caller obligation.
